heading: Effective date of certain rules
lead: Notwithstanding section 801— shall take effect at such time as the Federal agency promulgating the rule determines.

tree.text: any rule that establishes, modifies, opens, closes, or conducts a regulatory program for a commercial, recreational, or subsistence activity related to hunting, fishing, or camping, or

any rule which an agency for good cause finds (and incorporates the finding and a brief statement of reasons therefor in the rule issued) that notice and public procedure thereon are impracticable, unnecessary, or contrary to the public interest,
